diagram_previews.alt: Two circles with six labelled points. Left: C, O, P on the upper arc and S, E, T on the lower arc, so the blue triangle COP and the red triangle SET are disjoint. Right: the points alternate C, S, O, E, P, T around the circle, and the two triangles cross, forming a six-pointed star.
